data.explanation: This is a conditional admission offer: it only turns into a firm place once you have proven your bachelor's degree. You need to upload a certified copy of your bachelor's certificate and your final transcript to the applicant portal by the deadline shown. If these documents do not arrive in time, the offer automatically lapses and you would need to reapply or contact the admissions office. It may help to start the certification process (e.g. at your university or a notary) well before the deadline, since certified copies can take time to obtain.
